lines.zh: 棕色的毛上有细碎斑点
lines.en: Fine flecks speckle my brown wool.
Four hooves on grass, swaying with each step.
Heavy wool makes for slow walking.
I work my way across the hillside.
A bite of grass, then onward.
My hoofprints sit shallow in the soil.

lines.zh: 斑点藏在毛里，远看看不出
lines.en: The flecks hide in my wool from a distance.
I skirt the boggy patch.
My tail sways in small arcs.
I walk wedged in with the flock.
Grass tips brush against my fleece.
I round a low tree.
I stop, then pick a new heading.
Thick wool gets warm after a while.
I raise my head to check the way.
I head toward that short grass.
Standing and chewing, my jaw working.

lines.zh: 把身子靠在一块石头上
lines.en: Leaning my side against a stone.
An ear flicks a fly away.
A grass stem pokes out of my wool.
I blink lazily.

lines.zh: 身上的斑点在阴影里更明显
lines.en: In shade the flecks show more clearly.
My head lowers, then comes up.
Another sheep is bleating.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖背，灰尘飞起来
lines.en: I shake my back and dust flies.
Wind lays my fleece to one side.
A hoof stirs the mud lightly.
I chew slowly, deliberately.
The flock crowds into a knot.
I lean my head on a fence post.
Sun brightens the surface of my wool.

lines.zh: 安静地站着，什么都不做
lines.en: Standing quietly, doing nothing.
I look up at you, still chewing.
You're much taller than the flock.
I tilt my head.
My wool is thick. Only my eyes show.
Your hand is reaching over.
I step back, then look again.
You can't count the flecks on me.
I give a short bleat.
I dip my head back to the grass.
My ears turned your way.
I eye what's in your hand.
Up to look, down to eat.
Thick wool, and it still hurts.
I shrink into the flock.
That hit my ribs.
My bleat comes short and sharp.
The flock scatters sideways.
A tear opens in my wool.

lines.zh: 羊毛再厚，也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Even this thick wool can't blunt that blow.
I shake my head and steady myself.
That makes me remember you.
I don't want to fight, only flee.
Grass in your hand smells better.
I shuffle a step your way.
Wheat would be even better.
The flock crowds in behind me.
I lower my nose to your hand.
I'll make this mouthful last.
Feed me and I'll follow.
Thick wool, but my nose still works.
Steam puffs from my muzzle as I chew.
One more handful. Just one.
A flockmate shoulders in from the side.
I block them with my body.
Finished. Want more.

lines.zh: 草比石头好，别的没兴趣
lines.en: Grass, not stones. Nothing else interests me.
Your sleeve smells of grass.
I push a little closer.
Thick wool. That bump didn't hurt.
You bumped into a pile of wool.
The flock shuffles to one side.
Don't push. I'm unsteady.
I turn and make a gap.
My hoof landed on your shoe.
My fleece picked up your scent.

lines.zh: 我顶回去，羊毛蹭了你一下。
lines.en: I butt back, wool brushing against you.
I ease back toward my flockmates.
Walking close is fine. Not too long.
I press my head to hers.
Two coats of wool pressed together.
I rub against her side.
Her flecks are denser than mine.
We lower our heads to graze as one.
I keep to her outer side.
She moves, and I'm half a step behind.
The flock stands around us.
Our wool will grow in before winter.
Staying quiet, no fuss.
I dip down and tear up a tuft.
A stem dangles from my wool.
Juice fills my mouth as I chew.
Fallen bits suit me fine.
This mouthful has grit in it.
Slow chew, slow swallow.
I let the one beside me have some.
One mouthful in, half still left.
I nuzzle the grass on the ground.
Done. I lick my nose.
Footsteps are approaching.
I raise my head, grass at my lips.
The flock goes silent.

lines.zh: 你的影子从坡上压过来
lines.en: Your shadow spills down the slope.
I press into the middle of the flock.
Every ear stands rigid.
Only watching. Not bolting yet.
My hoof taps the ground.
I put myself in front of the lamb.
My nostrils puff out a breath.
I keep watching and dare not graze.
The flock edges to the far side.
I shield them and retreat slowly.
You take one step, we take one back.
The grass is trampled into a mess.
I'm counting how far off you are.
Under the wool my heart races.
My bleat has gone clipped.
The crest of the slope is behind us.
Any closer and we scatter.
I butt you with my head.
My forehoof throws up a clod of dirt.

lines.zh: 撞过去，只是要把你推开
lines.en: I charge only to push you back.
Wool padding. The impact barely registers.
I turn and block with my rump.
That went wide and didn't land.
My hoof stamps beside your foot.
Bleating, I pull back.
A flockmate butts in alongside me.
After the shove I pant twice.

lines.zh: 坡上多了一团棕色的毛
lines.en: A brown mass of wool appears on the slope.

lines.zh: 我先抖了抖身上的草屑
lines.en: I shake the grass bits off first.
Four hooves settle into the soft earth.
The flecks on my wool shift in the light.
The flock answers from a distance.
I dip my head for grass at once.
Little wind here. Comfortable.

lines.zh: 我朝羊群的方向挪过去
lines.en: I drift toward the flock.
A line of prints leads downslope.
I bleat once, not loudly.
Fire mats my wool into burnt clumps.
A hoof slips out on landing.
Wet wool is heavy. I sink.
The blast rolls me onto my side.
Something buries itself in my wool.
A sour ache spreads through my bones.
Hunger makes my bleat faint.
Lightning makes my wool stand on end.
The soil beneath me vanishes.
